title: Shared query parameters
description: Query parameters shared by list and search routes. A route accepts the ones that apply to it. A time range on a named field uses that field as a prefix, such as updated_from and updated_to.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Values above 200 return 200.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from next_cursor of the previous page. Valid only for the same query and the same caller.

from.description: Start of the range, inclusive. RFC 3339 timestamp with offset, or a YYYY-MM-DD day meaning the start of that day.

to.description: End of the range. A timestamp is exclusive. A YYYY-MM-DD day includes that whole day.

tz.description: IANA time zone used to resolve YYYY-MM-DD days. Defaults to UTC.

sort.description: Comma-separated fields. A leading - sorts that field descending.
